user.title: Connect KumaFlow Brain
user.description: Enter the brain address and a token. The token comes from the `BRAIN_API_TOKEN` env var of the `backend` service, or from Settings → API tokens in the brain web UI. Buttons require an `admin` scope token.

data.user_id: User ID (for the My Wave button)

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address, the token, and that the brain is running.

abort.already_configured: This brain address is already configured.
